title: provenance.json of a document set (A2)
description: Frozen in phase 001. Written by k2gen docset beside the documents it extracts from `git archive <tag>` of k2gen.model.DOCUMENT_ROOTS, and copied unchanged into each release compiled from that set. The registry, after 3.0, writes the same record with source registry (ADR-055 part 7).

source.description: Which store the set came from.

tag.description: The release tag: an annotated tag, since its tagger is the approver.

tagger.description: Who applied the tag, as git records it: the release's approver.

taggedAt.description: When the tag was applied, UTC.

setSha256.description: k2gen.model.set_sha256 over every document: the sha256 of the lines `<sha256>  <path>\n`, sorted by path, as sha256sum prints them.

documents.description: Every document in the set, sorted by path.

path.description: The document's path in the repository.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the document's bytes.

lastCommit.description: The last commit at or before the tag that changed the document.

pr.description: The pull request of that commit, parsed from its subject's (#NNN); null when the subject names none.

sha1.description: A git commit, 40 lower-case hex digits.
